designationHistory.name: Piedmont Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Piedmont Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8037 on January 18, 1939, on worn-out farmland bought for wildlife restoration.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Piedmont National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 8037, Jan. 18, 1939, Establishing the Piedmont Wildlife Refuge
National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables 1939: EO 8037, 4 FR 391

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date and EO added.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Piedmont National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1939 as a "combination wildlife and game-management demonstration area" to demonstrate that wildlife could be restored on worn out, eroded lands.
